# MM-P2-L2-RR03 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Scope
- This manual describes required preventive maintenance and adjustment steps for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03). Follow referenced procedures SB-1049, SOP-P2-L2-03, and SOP-P2-L2-05 for safety and lockout/tagout requirements.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated to cover 620 N·m.
- Standard hand tools and inspection mirror.
- Grease gun compatible with machine fittings.
- Bearing inspection dye and lint-free wipes.
- Personal protective equipment per SB-1049.

Procedure
- Verify machine is de-energized per SOP-P2-L2-03 and locked out per SOP-P2-L2-05.
- Inspect visible surfaces of EQ-P2-L2-RR03 for wear, cracks, or oil leaks; clean as required.
- Check mandrel clamp fasteners for play. Apply specified tightening sequence and set mandrel clamp bolt torque. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m.
- Access main roll bearing lubrication fittings. Remove dust caps and inspect threads and seals for damage. Apply grease until seals show fresh lubricant and excess is purged per grease gun guidance.
- Record lubrication event and runtime since last service. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 185 hours. Schedule next service accordingly.
- Reinstall guards and perform a low-speed function check per SOP-P2-L2-03. Confirm no abnormal noise or vibration before returning machine to production.

Acceptance criteria
- All mandrel clamp bolts achieve the specified torque without evidence of thread stripping or washer deformation.
- Main roll bearings receive lubricant and show no signs of metal contamination or significant leakage after the grease purge.
- Post-maintenance functional test shows normal operation with no abnormal noise, vibration, or temperature rise.
- Maintenance activity documented and cross-referenced to SB-1049, SOP-P2-L2-03, and SOP-P2-L2-05 in the equipment log.
